name: 85392 · Avondale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85392 (Avondale) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85392 (Avondale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
